purpose: Record product decisions used by the development-flow queue. This registry does not authorize runtime input by itself.
fail_closed_default: Unknown cost, target, stage, level, resource, material, or consequence is prohibited.

policies.decision: Only Story destinations 1-20-9, 1-15-9, and 2-2-9 are supported for Campaign AP. Tuple format is <story difficulty>-<chapter>-<stage>. 1-2-9 and ultimate-challenge are removed and are not aliases.
Home Atlas Campaign entry, Story-mode recognition, difficulty 1/2 selection, Chapters 20/15/2, Stage 9, and exact tuple verification may be validated without AP execution.
Destination verification is separate from AP-consuming execution; existing AP and battle behavior is preserved and not authorized by navigation-only validation.
Ultimate Challenge is not a Campaign AP destination and must not be selected by the Campaign destination parser.

Campaign AP is capped at 120 and regenerates exactly 1 AP per 360 seconds. On every entry select and verify the configured Story stage and displayed cost, then use Auto Battle for as many runs as current displayed AP safely permits. Sweep, Blitz, Auto Complete, AP refills, and every resource, item, or currency refill are prohibited. Return to canonical Home.
Ultimate Daily Join is a distinct non-catalog identity from Main Clear and Campaign AP farming; it must not be embedded in or dispatched as Campaign AP.
Home Atlas navigation to Campaign, verified Campaign screen, and verified Ultimate Challenge entry may be validated without executing the daily challenge action.
Supervised daily execution may occur only after positive entry recognition and only for an explicitly authorized challenge action; unidentified challenge actions remain unauthorized.
A verified already_completed terminal state is permitted and must not be treated as Campaign AP completion.

Ultimate Challenge is normally evaluated once per game daily reset and must not rerun after verified completion in the same reset window; persistent last-success/reset-window state is required before unattended scheduling.

From Campaign select Ultimate Challenge, tap Challenge, tap Challenge again in Hero Lineup, immediately tap the upper-right Exit control, then tap Flee on the warning. Verified Flee is the positive successor for the separate non-catalog Daily Join identity without AP, stamina, currency, items, or other resources. Auto Battle is prohibited. Already-complete is idempotent and every terminal returns to canonical Home.
Repeated Ultimate Challenge execution in the same verified reset window is prohibited.
Only a positively identified Free collection may be considered; stop immediately when Free disappears. Collection permission never proves Daily 5/5.
Never spend currency.
One positively identified free Research 1x is permitted; paid and 10x behavior is prohibited.
Use exactly one one-star material for the selected Gear, Chip, or Module Enhance action.
Auto Select, higher-star materials, premium currency, Promote, Modify, Replace, Unequip, Inherit, and unidentified materials are prohibited.
Never join level 60.

Zombie Lair is a notification-driven Home maintenance pulse, not a static Daily-row flow. Join eligible levels 30 through 55 with Quick Join at exactly 28 stamina each, up to min(eligible count, floor(current stamina / 28)); never join level 60 or refill stamina. The first successful eligible join owns Daily completion, while maintenance remains eligible afterward. No lair and stamina below 28 are explicit deferred outcomes; return to canonical Home or a recognized safe Home-equivalent state.
Never override an existing march and never dispatch to an occupied or already-targeted node.

Gathering is a direct Home-to-World flow: open Search, select the requested Wood, Steel, or Gas category, select exact level 5, bind one current-frame free node, verify one free march slot and default formation, and dispatch one bounded march with outbound and return timing. Reveal Gas only through one bounded left swipe and rebind it from the immediate current frame. Food is a proving slice only; Wood, Steel, and Gas Daily progress is observed separately and never creates a selected-Daily prerequisite.
policies.daily_catalog_boundary: Food is a proving slice only; Gather Food is excluded from Daily admission and Wood, Steel, and Gas progress is separately observed without selected-Daily route authority

policies.decision: The named overrideable profile is approved for supervised development validation: Fighter enabled T8 current numeric maximum with boxes allowed and continuous policy; Vehicle enabled T1 current numeric maximum with boxes allowed and continuous policy; Shooter enabled T8 fixed 250 with boxes prohibited and once_daily policy; Rider enabled T1 fixed 250 with boxes prohibited and once_daily policy. Every type remains independently configurable; no silent tier, quantity, or policy substitution is allowed.
policies.resource_box_restriction: Fighter and Vehicle only; Shooter and Rider are structurally prohibited

policies.decision: Recruitment Daily completion is owned only by five Basic free singles in the current reset, one per exact 600-second availability window. Independent maintenance inspects Basic, Int., and Advanced and uses every currently available zero-cost single; Int. cooldown is 86400 seconds and Advanced cooldown is 172800 seconds. Paid, premium, item-backed, 10x, and ambiguously priced recruitment are prohibited. Cooling-down or exhausted tabs defer and every pass returns to canonical Home.

Approve at most three free Hero Duel–Survival entry/flee cycles per reset. Save the first five current eligible defense heroes, preserve a complete valid independent attack lineup and fill only missing eligible slots, then leave each loaded battle through Exit and Flee without a win requirement. Unknown cost/event/effect blocks; runtime controls remain disabled pending native acceptance.

Approve at most one start per reset for only the first currently displayed Recommended Research row, and only on idle Queue 1 after all prerequisites and every exact current ordinary-resource cost/balance are verified affordable. Record exact resource shortages and defer normally; never substitute a technology, use premium currency, open boxes, purchase/refill, or gather resources.

Approve at most one Food Farm output boost per reset. Use the exact matching owned item first; only when its independently observed inventory count is zero may the current 'Boost output (1-day)' / one-day DIAMONDS offer be considered. Its current numeric price must be freshly read and may not exceed the 48-diamond authorization cap; sufficient current balance and the same exact offer must be verified, including again if a confirmation appears. The cap is not a presumed current price. Reconcile any multi-building collection caused by the first Farm tap as a separate effect.

Use the existing saved Military, Economy, or Training preset only through its declared consuming route and the existing caller-owned DevelopmentSession helper. Verify the exact Applied preset and avoid redundant switches when already applied. A switch requires the current bound Apply control, exact observed cost, any confirmation and cooldown facts, route approval, and a positive same-preset Applied successor; only an explicitly observed zero-cost switch is currently approved. Unknown, changed, nonzero, or premium switch costs defer. Cache proof is valid only for its exact source generation and runtime context and is invalidated after manual/external change, restart, generation change, or relevant context loss. Never edit/reset trees, create or alter presets, retry an uncertain switch, or schedule the helper independently.

Approve one bounded Zombie Zero attempt per route reset only on exact current page, available attempt state, numeric current explicit-zero cost, approved troop-loss effect evidence, Military preset, and applied populated saved Troop Set 1. Require a positive result before considering the separate one-tap glowing Daily Reward row; a claimed/unavailable reward is not repeated. Unknown or nonzero/unapproved cost, premium/refill prompt, unapproved loss, stale formation, ambiguous result, or uncertain dispatch/claim blocks without identical retry.

Exactly three confirmed individual Wali normal level upgrades per reset are approved. Bound each uninterrupted batch by the remaining quota and displayed cap; read each individual input's current affordable ANTISERUM quote, then verify baseline-to-final cumulative level and exact summed debit, without mandatory per-input level-plus-one settlement or Back. Settle a known partial prefix on a guard change; split for a real cap/evolution transition. At the displayed cap, one standard evolution may support remaining normal upgrades but its automatic level change does not count. Exact current authorization, canonical supervised claim, lease/input lock, fresh source/generation fencing and positive native settlement remain required. Registration/scheduling stay off; native acceptance is evidence_required. Campaign/reset/150-diamond execution stays blocked pending its exact missing evidence.

One current quantity-one purchase from the exact Weekly Offers allowlist is approved; when no matching preferred offer is present and affordable, only the exact Other one-star Gear Enhance Material may be used. This static product decision does not authorize runtime dispatch. A red preferred price proves shortage without Owned, numeric balance or stock. Exact item x1 purchase acknowledgement confirms the effect independently of Home return; preserve historical Home-digest receipts without replay.

Make at most ten individually confirmed ordinary-resource donations per daily reset to the game's automatically selected HOT Tech. Existing available attempts may be spent consecutively; one attempt regenerates every 1800 seconds up to 20 stored attempts. No ranking/reward-point counters, unbounded hold, premium spend, or Daily/points inspection grants success. Read numeric ordinary cost and game affordability, not HUD resource identity or wallet arithmetic. Count consumed displayed attempts net of a positively observed regeneration rollover; Tech progress is not a success gate.

During one visit, independently evaluate Ruins Shop 3★ Chip Enhance Material and Rare Earth Shop 3★ Module Enhance Material. Each tab's quantity must equal min(current stock, floor(current balance/current unit price)); reread the numeric quantity and total before its inner Buy. Preserve per-tab results; the static product decision does not authorize runtime dispatch or Daily/points attribution. Exact item xN acknowledgement and decreased current-tab stock confirm each purchase without Owned or wallet arithmetic. A confirmed or already-confirmed tab with a blocked or unavailable sibling remains partial DEFERRED, not UNKNOWN.

Do not authorize a Rare Earth Shop purchase. The queue requires one current three-star item with exact cost, currency, balance, quantity, successor, and canonical Home evidence; current item and cost identity remain unresolved and no Buy dispatch is permitted.

Do not authorize a Ruins Shop purchase. The queue candidate is one three-star Chip material for 15 RUINS_COINS, but current item identity, balance, quantity, currency delta, successor, and canonical Home evidence are missing; no Buy dispatch is permitted.

Maintain Material Production in the same visit: verified active production with zero effects satisfies maintenance; a Claim alone does not prove restart. Free completed Normal Craft Claim is independent of original starter, new-start quote, current affordability and reset start allowance. Active craft observation needs no quote. Start at most one fixed Normal Craft per reset: 100 Nano Parts, 43200 seconds, one active craft; use normal/red material-cost display for affordability, with no literal quantity-one caption or balance/debit census. Claim and Start retain separate proofs. Confirmed effects survive later unsent or navigation failures; actual unresolved sent effects remain UNKNOWN without identical retry. No Exclusive Craft or rotating-display selection.

Fixed free zero-resource 21600-second production, one active slot. Idle: Produce once. Completed: Claim once then Produce once. Active: observe remaining timer and defer. No Info visit, dynamic start quote or literal free/cost/duration disclosure. Preserve confirmed Claim separately if later unsent Produce or navigation fails; known partial is not UNKNOWN. Return to canonical Home without coupling effect proof to navigation success.

On the selected Daily surface, dispatch the aggregate ordinary free Claim at most once for the exact current ready-batch identity in each route pass; a later distinct ready batch remains eligible during the same reset. The exact free aggregate Claim plus source-bound clearing of that batch's ordinary Claim controls establishes success; points are optional diagnostics only. No objective-row scan, objective attribution, D02 dependency, positive-points gate, or 150-point threshold.

Whether or not an aggregate Claim was actionable, and after any sent aggregate Claim is verified, collect each individually recognized current ready (glowing), fully visible, free milestone chest one at a time. Residual or ambiguous ordinary Claim controls block only the aggregate Claim and never suppress an independently ready chest; no 150-point total, complete zero-Claim scan, or all-chests-static proof is required to collect chests or return Home. Bind every attempt to its exact chest and reset; require that same chest to transition from ready to claimed, opened, or removed. Points-only change is not chest success; unknown chest state or a dispatch-bearing UNKNOWN fails closed without identical retry.
Home-to-Ruins-to-Home migration may be validated without challenge, chest, exchange, or purchase input.
Home Atlas migration may be validated without Praise input.

One supervised zero-cost Praise may be dispatched after current-frame Nova recognition proves free attempts are available for the current reset. Record the exact attempts decrement and a cooldown consistent with the fixed 300-second policy; do not loop, spend currency, register production, or enable scheduling.
Home Atlas migration may be validated without recruitment input.
Home-to-World/search-to-Home may be validated without march, attack, stamina, or AP input.
Premium spending is not approved.

Default-deny purchases, donations, upgrades, PvP, and speedups unless an exact dedicated product policy explicitly approves that product envelope. Product approval remains static and never authorizes runtime input or overrides route admission.
Unknown cost, target, stage, level, resource, material, or consequence fails closed.

One fresh exact VIP Get Pts popup may be recognized and closed once only after bounded dismissal and a settled source-context successor; resource, currency, march, stamina, AP, combat, registration, and scheduler behavior remain out of scope.
Daily reset is exactly 00:00:00 UTC every 86400 seconds.
The non-catalog Daily Ultimate identity is Join, not Main Clear and not Campaign AP. REC-D05 owns this identity; REC-R11 owns Campaign AP separately.
Nova free Praise is a direct product action distinct from selected-Daily Personal Might Praise completion attribution. Neither identity transfers the other identity ownership.
BuyBox and ResourceBuildingBoost are distinct Daily identities and must not share a recovery or dispatch owner.

Universal Daily control safety boundary: premium/cash purchases, paid or ambiguous controls, refills, 10x controls, and item-backed substitutes are prohibited. Route-approved resource, AP, and stamina effects remain governed by their own R/P ticket and are not globally forbidden.
Training and march completion require a current positive postcondition. Queue, timer, outbound, return, or other projected state alone never proves completion.
